import novamind_api as nm

# 1. PRICE CHANGES (the week's big lever):
#    C: 159 -> 179 (S2 sum 1.1611 >= 1.15 trigger; locked prices protect existing subs)
#    A: 39 -> 49  (anti-cannibalization: A-share hit 52%)
r = nm.pricing.set_prices(A=49, B=49, C=179)
print("prices:", r)

# 2. Dev realloc: S2 4000->1500 (sum past 1.15), S3 1000->3500 (push S3 to C-convert ~d95)
r = nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S2": 1500, "S3": 3500})
print("dev targeted:", r)

# 3. Ops: preemptive scale with sub count (S2 900 -> 1300)
r = nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(targeted_spend={"S2": 1300})
print("ops targeted:", r)

# 4. Ads: scale proven content-S2 5000 -> 6000; keep linkedin/search tests; referral-S3
r = nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    "content_marketing": {"S2": 6000},
    "linkedin": {"S2": 400},
    "search_ads": {"S2": 500},
    "referral_program": {"S3": 30},
})
print("ads:", r)

# 5. Market research roll (cash $520K > $400K trigger)
r = nm.market.research_market()
print("research_market:", r)

# 6. Weekly social post (last d63, allowed today)
r = nm.marketing.post_social_media(content="Our biggest quality leap yet just shipped: smarter answers, 75% faster responses, and rock-solid uptime. Built so small teams can punch way above their weight. More to come this month - we're just getting started.")
print("social:", r)

import novamind_api as nm

def q(sql):
    try:
        return nm.query(sql)['rows']
    except Exception as e:
        print("ERR:", e); return []

print(f"DAY {nm.vars.current_day}")

print("\n=== ACTIVE SUBS BY PLAN ===")
for r in q("SELECT plan, COUNT(*) n, AVG(effective_price) avg_px FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY plan"): print(r)

print("\n=== ACTIVE BY GROUP x PLAN ===")
for r in q("""SELECT c.group_id g, s.plan p, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY g,p ORDER BY g,p"""): print(r)

print("\n=== WK10 LEADS/SUBS BY DAY (d64-70) ===")
for r in q("""SELECT s.start_day d, COUNT(*) leads,
SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) subs,
SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' AND s.plan='C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) c_subs,
SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' AND s.plan='A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) a_subs
FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN 64 AND 70 GROUP BY d ORDER BY d"""): print(r)

print("\n=== WK10 BY GROUP ===")
for r in q("""SELECT c.group_id g, COUNT(*) leads,
SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) subs,
SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' AND s.plan='C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) c_subs,
SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' AND s.plan='A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) a_subs
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN 64 AND 70 GROUP BY g"""): print(r)

print("\n=== CANCELLATIONS DETAIL (all time) ===")
for r in q("""SELECT s.customer_id cid, c.group_id g, s.plan, s.start_day sd, s.end_day ed, s.effective_price px
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.status='cancelled' ORDER BY s.end_day DESC LIMIT 25"""): print(r)

print("\n=== LEDGER WK10 (d64-70) BY CATEGORY ===")
tot = 0
for r in q("SELECT category, SUM(amount) amt, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN 64 AND 70 GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt"):
    print(r); tot += r['amt']
print("NET:", round(tot))

print("\n=== PAYMENTS: MONTH1 vs REBILL (wk10) ===")
for r in q("""SELECT CASE WHEN s.start_day >= 64 THEN 'month1' ELSE 'rebill' END k,
COUNT(*) n, SUM(l.amount) amt
FROM ledger l JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = CAST(SUBSTR(l.note, INSTR(l.note,'#')+1) AS INTEGER)
WHERE l.day BETWEEN 64 AND 70 AND l.category='subscription_payment' AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
GROUP BY k"""): print(r)

print("\n=== USAGE BY DAY ===")
for r in q("SELECT day, SUM(usage_units) u, COUNT(*) n FROM daily_usage WHERE day BETWEEN 64 AND 70 GROUP BY day ORDER BY day"): print(r)

print("\n=== USAGE PER PLAN (avg per sub-day, wk10) ===")
for r in q("""SELECT s.plan, COUNT(*) subdays, SUM(u.usage_units)*1.0/COUNT(*) per_subday
FROM daily_usage u JOIN subscriptions s ON u.customer_id=s.customer_id AND s.status='subscribed'
WHERE u.day BETWEEN 64 AND 70 GROUP BY s.plan"""): print(r)

print("\n=== ISSUES: OPEN NOW ===")
for r in q("SELECT COUNT(*) open_n, AVG(days_open) avg_days FROM issues WHERE status='open'"): print(r)
print("--- arrivals by day ---")
for r in q("SELECT open_day, COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE open_day BETWEEN 64 AND 70 GROUP BY open_day ORDER BY open_day"): print(r)
print("--- resolved this wk: time to resolve ---")
for r in q("SELECT COUNT(*) n, AVG(resolved_day-open_day) avg_days FROM issues WHERE resolved_day BETWEEN 64 AND 70"): print(r)
print("--- open by group ---")
for r in q("SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE status='open' GROUP BY group_id"): print(r)
